Even the Mojave is reportedly going IFS...

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Stop tracking email opens without disabling other tracking
items.description: Choose whether to track email opens separately from other tracking in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys. A dedicated consent purpose lets you omit tracking pixels from new emails while link clicks, website interactions, UTM parameters, and form prefill continue to follow their existing tracking consent settings.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Improved device settings experience on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: We’re enhancing the on-device admin settings experience for Teams Rooms on Android by improving information structure, organization and navigation. These updates make it easier for admins to find, understand, and adjust device settings directly from the console, improving overall usability and efficiency in room management.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Set wait times as short as 5 seconds in orchestration playbooks
items.description: Orchestration playbooks can now re-evaluate the conditions every 5 seconds instead of every 30 seconds. With this shorter interval, you get finer control over priority escalation and Bullseye pool expansion. As a result, conversations reach the right queue or specialist sooner when wait times or queue status change.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Human Resources: Expand talent sourcing through employee referrals
items.description:
Employee referrals provide organizations with an additional talent-sourcing channel by enabling employees to participate actively in the recruitment process.
This capability helps organizations:
Expand talent reach: Access potential candidates through employees' professional networks.
Reduce recruitment costs: Decrease reliance on external recruitment channels and agencies.
Accelerate hiring: Identify potential candidates more quickly through employee recommendations.
Improve employee engagement

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Customize how Recommended Actions are prioritized with custom instructions
items.description:
Administrators can customize how the Recommended Actions agent prioritizes actions by configuring natural-language instructions for individual source agents. This gives organizations greater flexibility to align AI-generated recommendations with their sales strategies while retaining the built-in intelligence of the Recommended Actions experience.
With this capability, administrators can:

Define business-specific prioritization criteria: Use natural-language instructions to express the organiza

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Trace conversation journeys end to end across your contact center
items.description: Journey Visualization brings live conversation data onto the map of your contact center configuration, so admins can see how conversations actually flow, not just how they were designed to flow. Admins can spot patterns across many conversations, then select any single conversation and follow its path step by step, from arrival through routing and queues to resolution.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Visualize and manage your contact center setup with visual designer
items.description: Visual Designer shows your entire contact center configuration as one interactive map: channels, workstreams, classification and routing rules, queues, and overflow handling, and how they connect. Admins can see how conversations will flow, spot gaps or misconfigurations, and make common changes, such as moving representatives between queues or updating routing, directly on the canvas instead of navigating many separate settings pages.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Choose a Profile at Startup
items.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing a profile picker at startup, making it easier to begin each browsing session with the right profile. Users can choose among their work, personal, or other available profiles, add a new profile, or browse as a guest before opening the browser. This helps users keep their browsing data and activities in the intended profile, while the Show on startup setting lets them control whether the picker appears at launch.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Raise your hand to speak up at large events with up to 100,000 attendees
items.description: Ask your questions live and take part in the conversation, even at events with up to 100,000 attendees. In events this size, attendees can now raise their hand in Teams when they have a question. Organizers can then let people with a raised hand turn on their mic and camera to ask their question or speak during the event.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Share reactions at events with up to 100,000 attendees
items.description: Stay more engaged and connected with the audience, even at events with up to 100,000 attendees. Teams now supports reactions in events at this scale. You can send reactions during the event and see the reactions others send, so everyone can share the moment together.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): The more you use Copilot in Office the better it gets
items.description: Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Workspaces across Copilot App and OneNote will use memory to learn your work patterns and personalize responses. With memory, Copilot can offer more relevant suggestions, hold the pen in a way that represents you, and adapt to your preferences over time

items.title: Outlook: Add Custom Flag Descriptions for Clearer Follow-Ups
items.description: You can add custom text to an email's follow-up flag to describe what you need to do. Use your own words to capture the next step for each flagged message. This gives you a clear reminder of why you flagged the email when you return to it. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: PowerPoint: Customize your Presenter view layout
items.description: New controls in Presenter view will let you reposition and resize the speaker notes, set speaker notes to a specific text size, and customize the position of slides and notes into a view that works for you. The existing layout will remain the default unless you change it.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Voice phishing detection for external calls
items.description: Voice phishing detection helps protect Microsoft Teams users from potential scams during one-to-one calls with people outside their organization. Using AI, Teams analyzes conversations for signs of social engineering and alerts recipients when suspicious activity is detected, helping them recognize potential threats and decide how to proceed.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Enable version trimming for data covered by retention policies in OneDrive and SharePoint
items.description: Let tenants trim file-version bloat created by retention, without breaking compliance promises. SharePoint/compliance admins at large, regulated enterprises must cap and reclaim storage consumed by retained file versions, while keeping legal-hold and records promises intact. Admins with appropriate Purview RBAC can enable version cleanup for ODB/SPO content even when retention policies are in effect. This would be a policy scoped setting that essentially overrides the default behavior where all

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Engage - Improved shared messages end-user experience
items.description: Improving the shared conversation experience in Viva Engage to so it's easier for users to discover, read, and participate.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Apply Purview network data security DLP policies to all websites, or all websites except specific cloud apps, through Entra GSA Internet Access integration
items.description: With this feature, admins can scope their network data security data loss prevention policies, integrated with Entra GSA Internet Access, to apply to all websites (.) or all websites except specific cloud apps, allowing them to apply protection to cloud apps and websites that are not in the Defender Cloud App Catalog.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events now support up to 20,000 registrations, making it easier to reach and engage larger audiences at scale
items.description: Connect with more attendees than ever before with Teams Events, now supporting up to 20,000 registrations for organizers with valid Attendee packs.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
items.description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

items.title: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
items.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

items.title: Planner: Capacity view
items.description: Capacity view shows a timeline of who's working on what, so you can see how work is distributed across your team and spot overload or open capacity at a glance.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
items.description: Access to Archive mailboxes (Main + Auxiliary) through Microsoft Graph. The goal is to give users a single, seamless Archive view, even though Archive data may physically reside across multiple auxiliary mailboxes with EWS Graph APIs getting deprecated by OCT 2026.
